verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Claude is available on Google Cloud through an API "nearly identical to the Messages API", and the model-ID docs mention per-platform ID tables, so the models are offered beyond Anthropic's own endpoint. Only one major cloud is actually named in the evidence. missing for 10: documented Bedrock availability, Azure availability, OpenRouter-class gateway availability, independent corroboration of multi-cloud parity.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint

citations.quote: The API for accessing Claude on Google Cloud's Agent Platform is nearly identical to the Messages API
